messages.subject: Multilevel point-in-polygon model
parts:
I was wondering if there was a tutorial for setting up a multilevel model where one level is individual coordinate pairs (which I would analyze as a GAM ordinarily, I suppose using the SPDE/Mesh approach in INLA), and the second level is a containing set of polygons (which I would ordinarily analyze as a bym model). It would be great if there are any worked through examples of something like this.

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Multilevel point-in-polygon model
parts:
When you say you ordinarily would use an spde and bym model for this, what’s he actual difference you desire for your “multilevel” model? From what I see, “multilevel” model is usually just a basic reformulation of additive models. What’s the actual difference you need?

Finn
